recentItems.title: I Survived 9/11 — I Was Buried for 13 Hours Under the Rubble | PEOPLE
recentItems.description:
On September 11, 2001, Will Jimeno was a rookie Port Authority police officer when he responded to the attacks on the World Trade Center. The collapse of the South Tower buried him and fellow officers beneath the rubble, leaving Jimeno trapped, unable to move and fighting to survive for 13 agonizing hours. “Hell. It was literally hell,” he recalls. “I’m buried. I’m literally being crushed. I just wanted to die.”

In this powerful interview, Jimeno recounts the devastation beneath the Twin Towers, the loss of fellow officer Dominick Pezzulo and the intimate conversations that helped him and Sgt. John McLoughlin hold on as they waited for rescue. Believing he might never make it home, Jimeno asked McLoughlin to radio a final message to his wife, who was seven months pregnant: He wanted their unborn daughter to be named Olivia. More than two decades later, Jimeno reflects on survival, sacrifice and the family that gave him a reason to keep fighting.
